sectors.trend: Mixed: Nvidia at decade-low P/E seen as buy opportunity; Micron surging on earnings; Meta re-rating on 12% growth; AI regulation risk rising with Sanders/Casar bill and Obama's 50/50 human-AI training comment
sectors.implications: Regulatory overhang could cap multiples short-term but Broadcom's $350B outlook and small-model efficiency (Olas) suggest AI capex cycle intact. Hedging demand in Nvidia credit swaps signals institutional caution.

sectors.trend: Oil above $103/bbl; Saudi pipeline restart fails to ease tightness; Venezuela freight costs surging; Trump calls for diesel export ban; Exxon sets 50M ton LNG target by 2030
sectors.implications: Structural supply tightness supports oil majors; diesel export ban could tighten domestic supply further. LNG transition accelerates for Exxon. Middle East diplomacy offers partial relief but insufficient.

sectors.trend: Yields at 20-year highs; long-bond ETF at record low; inflation jitters driving Asian bond drops; Fed hike bets strengthening; USD rallying
sectors.implications: Duration risk is elevated. Rising yields pressure equities and housing. Mortgage rates finding slight relief but bond market stress dominates. Inflation data (Bessent's wage measure) complicates Fed path.

sectors.trend: UBS hit by 90% capital plan; Citigroup sets up Paramount loan calls; Peloton $800M bond debut; Kalshi seeks margin trading approval; private market access expanding
sectors.implications: Regulatory tightening in Swiss banking pressures UBS. US credit markets active with new issuance. Prediction markets expanding regulatory perimeter.

sectors.trend: McDonald's at 2-year low with Monopoly promotion; Walmart pricing patents spark surveillance fears; Royal Caribbean nears $6B Sandals deal; DoorDash $131.5M NYC settlement
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary under pressure. Data privacy concerns around dynamic pricing could face regulatory scrutiny. M&A activity in leisure sector continues.

sectors.trend: GLP-1 drug lawsuits multiply with vision-loss claims; hundreds of patients suing drug companies
sectors.implications: Litigation risk building for GLP-1 manufacturers (Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly). Potential product liability exposure could impact valuations if class actions expand.

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Bond yields at 20-year highs and oil >$103 create inflationary pressure that conflicts with equity valuations. Tech provides intraday support but AI regulation headlines (Sanders/Casar) cap upside. US-China truce and crypto strength offer pockets of optimism. Expect 5-8% volatility in equities over next 30 days. Fed rate hike bets will dominate narrative.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (Broadcom $350B, small-model efficiency) supports tech leadership through 2027. Energy transition (Exxon LNG, oil tightness) favors integrated majors. Housing market stabilizes as mortgage rates find room to fall. Key risk: post-Jan 10 trade escalation and AI regulatory crackdown could trigger 10-15% correction. OECD sees AI investment offsetting Middle East energy shock partially.
